name: All 96 campaign Bosses have complete bilingual entrances matched to their level and identity
A new run shows its entrance before any deal, coin or enemy deployment
Changing language, returning home and refreshing preserve the pending scene and exact prepared decks
Skipping the scene opens the real coin and preserves the five/six-card opening and draw order
A double start resolves only one opening deal and one coin
The next Boss introduction precedes its first enemy deployment and fresh sacrifices remain immature
Rereading the current entrance does not advance the turn, redeal or alter any combat card
Replaying a cleared Boss also introduces it first without replacing the saved main battle
Old in-progress v1.0.1 checkpoints resume their exact battle without inserting a new entrance
Long entrance paragraphs and start/home controls remain reachable on four screens in both languages
No browser errors during entrance, continuation and legacy scenarios
